description: This file is a shell script implementing the logic for resolving multiple tree objects during a complex merge operation in Git. It handles merging multiple branches or commits (octopus merge), checks for local changes, finds common ancestors, performs fast-forward merges, and manages conflicts.

methods.name: resolve_trees
methods.description: Main logic to resolve multiple tree objects for an octopus merge in Git, handling fast-forwards, conflicts, and merge failures.
